movie.title: The Prestige
movie.overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

facts: Did you know the rivalry between the two magicians isn't just a simple spat? It's explicitly described as a "life-long battle for supremacy," highlighting the incredible depth of their obsession to outdo each other!
The story delves much deeper than just magic tricks, being "full of obsession, deceit and jealousy." It promises a truly psychological and complex exploration of human nature.

This intense competition between the magicians leads to far more than just professional disagreements. The text hints at "dangerous and deadly consequences," making it clear the stakes are incredibly high!
